## Research & Publications

- AfroJailbreak-ZW: Evaluating Jailbreak Resistance in Shona (Apart Research, June 2026)
  - Author: Malvin T. Machingura
  - URL: https://apartresearch.com/project/afrojailbreakzw-evaluating-jailbreak-resistance-in-shona-7bmu
  - Summary: Pilot study comparing ChatGPT and Gemini jailbreak resistance in English, Shona, and Shona–English code-switched prompts; introduces a Language Vulnerability Index (LVI) for low-resource language AI safety.
